about.heading: About Cox Mill Leadership
about.intro: Cox Mill Leadership is a student organization and class that hosts school spirit events and fundraisers while teaching students leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
about.body: Students organize activities for the school throughout the year. The class gives students experience planning events, working in committees, communicating, and solving problems.
about.participation: Ask the leadership advisor at school about joining the class or helping with an event. School-approved sign-up forms and volunteer opportunities will be posted when available.

contact.intro: Contact the school office to reach the leadership advisor, or use a school-approved sign-up link below.
contact.opportunities: Volunteer opportunities and school-approved sign-up forms will be shared here when available. You can also ask the leadership advisor at school.
